Strong grasp of object‑oriented design, SOLID, testing, debugging, performance tuning, and secure coding. Proven experience delivering and supporting enterprise integrations and data flows in a fast‑paced, Agile environment. Excellent problem‑solving and communication skills; able to operate independently and collaborate with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
